recent.statement: The VIX fear gauge will rise above 20 within the next week
recent.evidence: The only signal shows VIX at 17.01, well below the 20 threshold, and no signal indicates any rise above 20 during the forecast window.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a significant increase in ship transits within the next week
recent.evidence: The most recent Strait of Hormuz signal shows only 10 daily transits, 52% below its 30-day average of 21, indicating a sharp decrease rather than a significant increase.

recent.statement: Typhoon NOUL-26 makes landfall or passes within 100 km of the Pearl River Delta, prompting Hong Kong/Guangdong storm signals and flight cancellations
recent.evidence: No signal mentions Typhoon Noul, the Pearl River Delta, or Hong Kong/Guangdong storm signals; the only tropical cyclone signals concern Dolphin, Genevieve, and Fausto in the Pacific far from China.

recent.statement: The US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by at least 25 basis points on July 28th
recent.evidence: No signal reports any FOMC rate decision or 25bp hike on July 28, 2026; the only central-bank signals list future meetings (Oct 2026 onward), and a Fed rate increase of this magnitude would certainly have appeared.

recent.statement: Aftershock of M4.0 or greater strikes the Kumamoto/Tsunagi area of Kyushu, Japan
recent.evidence: S1 reports a seismic shock of M5.0 at Kikuyo (32.9,130.8) in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, exceeding the stated M4.0 threshold in the forecast's area.

recent.statement: FOMC holds the federal funds target range unchanged at its July 28 meeting
recent.evidence: No signal reports the outcome of the July 28, 2026 FOMC meeting; the admissible signals only list future scheduled FOMC meetings (Sept 15, Oct 27, Jan 26, Apr 27), so nothing shows a hold decision occurred within the window.

recent.statement: Japan's Kumamoto region (near Tsunagi/Uki) records another M4.0 or greater aftershock
recent.evidence: S1 reports an M5.0 seismic shock at Kikuyo in Kumamoto Prefecture (32.9,130.8), exceeding the M4.0 threshold for a further Kumamoto-region quake.

recent.statement: The Federal Reserve will raise interest rates by at least 25 basis points during their meeting on July 28.
recent.evidence: No signal reports any FOMC rate decision or hike on July 28, 2026; the only central-bank signal references a scheduled meeting in April 2027, so a 25bp hike is unsupported.

recent.statement: Another M4.0+ aftershock strikes the Kumamoto/Tsunagi area of Kyushu, Japan
recent.evidence: S1 reports a seismic shock of M5.0 at 32.9,130.8 in Kikuyo, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, exceeding the M4.0 threshold in the forecast's Kumamoto area.

recent.statement: WTI front-month settles above $78/bbl, holding the backwardated structure amid Iran-Ukraine escalation
recent.evidence: No signal reports any WTI settlement price or futures curve structure; the only signal is a geopolitical headline about Iran-Ukraine tensions, so the $78/bbl settlement and backwardation claim is unsupported within the closed window.

recent.statement: A magnitude 4.0 or greater aftershock strikes within 100 km of Tsunagi, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan
recent.evidence: S1 reports an M5.0 seismic shock at Kikuyo, Japan (32.9,130.8), roughly 80 km from Tsunagi, satisfying the M4.0+ within-100 km threshold.

recent.statement: Ship transits through the Strait of Hormuz will be suspended due to increased tensions in the region within the next week
recent.evidence: The Strait of Hormuz still recorded 10 daily ship transits during the window — reduced but not suspended — and no signal reports any suspension of transits.
